acceptedDecisions.title: DrawCommand::Custom is cut (2026-07-02): YAGNI escape hatch, no consumer
acceptedDecisions.decision: Source: the old backlog file (now a historical archive), entry gridui-task-14 and its pruning decisions of 2026-07-02. DrawCommand::Custom is CUT: it is not present in the code and is a YAGNI escape hatch with no consumer. Full-scene bloom (gridui-task-13, P018(F004)/T100) is deferred until a real consumer exists. The full list of Grid UI pruning decisions and their reasons is on P028(F004).
acceptedDecisions.rationale: No widget needs to draw a raw custom command; adding an open escape hatch with no user invites bypassing the typed draw commands.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Closes P018(F004)/T099 as cut. T100 (bloom) stays planned but deferred until a consumer exists.
